cuba.title: Flag of Cuba

colors.note: Represents the three departments of Cuba
Represents the blood shed for independence

desc: - Five horizontal stripes alternating blue and white, with a red equilateral triangle at the hoist bearing a white five-pointed star
trivia:
- The red triangle represents independence and bloodshed; it is called a 'solstice triangle'
- The five stripes represent the original five provinces of Cuba
- The flag was designed by Narciso López in 1849, making it one of the oldest flags in the Americas
